title: Default sort order
prompt: Type exactly what this program prints.

code.typescript:
const nums: number[] = [10, 9, 1, 100, 25]
console.log([...nums].sort())
console.log([...nums].sort((a, b) => a - b))
const words = ['banana', 'Cherry', 'apple']
console.log(words.sort())
console.log(nums.indexOf(100), nums.includes(25))

hints: Without a comparator, sort compares values as strings.
Uppercase letters come before lowercase in UTF-16 order.
